description: This file defines the ReturnStatus class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing return statuses in the system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving return status records, handling descriptions in multiple languages, and caching results.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Class encapsulating CRUD operations and retrieval methods for return status entries, supporting multiple languages and cache management in the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Creates a new return status record in the database, adding descriptions for multiple languages, and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Updates an existing return status by deleting the old record and adding new descriptions, then clears cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status record from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return status records associated with a specific language ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return status record based on its ID, filtered by current language setting.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return status records, optionally filtered and sorted, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return status records for a given language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description for a return status in a specific language into the database.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific description of a return status in a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return status across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
